Chhattisgarh ends token system for fertilizer distribution

The Chhattisgarh government has ended the token system for fertilizer distribution, a move expected to benefit 40 lakh farmers. This change aims to ensure farmers receive their full fertilizer quota at once. The government has also taken action against fertilizer black marketing, suspending licenses of two sales centers and issuing notices to 40 others.
